name: M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed_subroot
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (p : List Bool), M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E p ⊆ M7.RecoveryPrefix.completed N w E []
guidance: Use ResiduePrefix.completed_membership and PrefixBits.base on p and []. Both share the actual Valid predicate. PrefixBits.root gives selected {0} and remaining range N minus {0}. Membership in the p completion implies zero selected in both natural supports and bounds within range N; use PrefixCompleted.Base and Within, or completed_bounds on a natural preimage. Thus it satisfies the root Within test. No signature-sector or class-validity extra hypothesis is required. Return tactic lines without leading by; keep exact frozen target and default limits.
